北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，保护呼吸道健康哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Haze in Beijing, wear a mask to protect your respiratory health!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，风力 3级，出门添衣注意保暖，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and cool with a 3-level wind. Layer up and stay warm!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感适中。小心忽冷忽热，带件薄外套备用哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast with a moderate feel. Carry a light jacket, temperatures can fluctuate!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感炎热，湿度大，记得多喝水、防晒，小心中暑哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels hot and humid. Stay hydrated, protect from sun, avoid heatstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感舒适偏热。注意防晒，保持清爽心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy and feels warm. Remember sun protection and stay cool!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，湿度略高。带把伞，心情也要保持晴朗哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast with some humidity. Take an umbrella and keep a sunny mood!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感宜人。享受这舒适的温度，注意出行安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and pleasant. Enjoy the comfy weather, stay safe on your travels.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感舒适。注意早晚温差，照顾好自己。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and comfortable. Mind the temperature changes, take care.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度低。驾车注意慢行，出行多加小心。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Wuhan, low visibility. Drive slowly and be extra careful when out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感舒适。别忘了带件外套，以防天气变化。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and comfortable. Don't forget a jacket, just in case.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感略凉。多喝热水，保持身体温暖舒适。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and a bit cool. Drink warm water to stay cozy and warm.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感较冷，风力 3级。记得多穿些，小心着凉感冒哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels quite cold with a 3-level wind. Bundle up to avoid catching a cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感舒适。享受阳光，但也要注意防晒哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and comfortable. Enjoy the sun, but remember sun protection.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，风力 3级。注意风大，带件薄外套防风。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast with a 3-level wind. Mind the wind, bring a light windbreaker.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，湿度大。出行注意安全，保持好心情。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Xiamen, high humidity. Stay safe when out, and keep a good mood.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感微凉，多云。记得添衣，别让凉风吹感冒啦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels a bit cool, partly cloudy. Add layers, don't let the chill get you!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，体感微凉。享受阳光，但也要注意保暖哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is clear and a bit cool. Enjoy the sunshine, but stay warm!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
